reason: The README describes an agent skill for searching public web sources to locate and summarize Chinese web-novel plots, chapters, characters, and update status, with multi-source cross-checking.

summaries.zh: 用于检索中文网络小说的剧情、章节、角色设定和更新状态，并汇总多个公开来源的信息。
summaries.en: An agent skill for searching public web sources to find and summarize Chinese web-novel plots, chapters, character details, and update status.

capabilities: Searches public web sources for Chinese web-novel information
Retrieves and locates novel directories, chapter content, characters, and plot details
Summarizes retrieved information and distinguishes confirmed details from title-based inference
Cross-checks information across multiple public sources
